description: Defines data structures and an interface for managing PDU sessions, including setup, modification, and removal, with related result structures and external dependencies.

classes.name: pdu_session_manager_ctrl
classes.description: Interface class for managing PDU sessions, including setup, modification, removal, and status retrieval.

methods.name: setup_pdu_session
methods.description: Sets up a new PDU session based on provided session request data.

methods.name: modify_pdu_session
methods.description: Modifies an existing PDU session with new parameters, including whether new tunnel info is required.

methods.name: remove_pdu_session
methods.description: Removes a PDU session identified by its session ID.

methods.name: get_nof_pdu_sessions
methods.description: Returns the number of active PDU sessions.

methods.name: get_pdu_session_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of PDU sessions.
